services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Lake Taneycomo offers great fishing all year round. The lake also offers terrific sightseeing opportunities with an incredible assortment of wildlife. Whatever interests you, we have a boat that can get you there. A pontoon boat is the most spacious and comfortable way to spend a day on the lake. An ideal choice for a family or small group. Our pontoon boats are 24 feet and 8-10 people will fit comfortably. We do have one pontoon voyager that will seat 14 people. services.name: Kayak Rentals
services.desc: There’s nothing quite like taking in the sun and breathtaking scenery while paddling a kayak in Lake Taneycomo. The sightseeing opportunities and incredible assortment of wildlife will add to your unforgettable Branson vacation memories. It is a kayak with a propelled system using your legs that allows you to fish and be hands free. Anyone age 16 and older can rent a kayak without parental consent. Anyone age 15 and younger will need parental consent and signature approval.
